description: Multi-repository longitudinal and cross-sectional benchmark dataset manifest for epistemological vitality and agent memory auditing.

experimental_conditions.Condition_A_Healthy: Optimal entropy band, low orphan rate (<5%), high dependency coverage (>85%), zero broken links.
experimental_conditions.Condition_B_Redundant: High structural entropy dispersion, duplicated entity variants, inflated candidate sets.
experimental_conditions.Condition_C_Fragmented: High orphan rate (>35%), missing associative links, disconnected subgraph islands.
experimental_conditions.Condition_D_Contradictory: Broken dependency pointers, outdated legacy rules conflicting with apex MOCs.
